about_v2: Re-solved with the puppet in the loop (shots/skinlab/resolve.html, driven by production/recognition/solve_v2/run.mjs): for each painting, solves[0] is the re-solve: the Pose Lab params whose PuppetCore.renderPose puppet, drawn in the painting's own registration, best matches it by (1 - silhouette IoU) + .04 x marker error (cm) + style priors (painted heads full size and upright as painted, standing legs uncrossed unless the painting's ankle markers cross, limbs painted at full length kept in the picture plane, marker error held within 1.3x the old + 1 cm). The old solves follow it unchanged. iou here is the PUPPET silhouette IoU (a proxy; the blind critic is the judge). Same schema as shots/rig/poses/.
